programs.title: Secrets Declassified With David Duchovny
programs.desc: Glimpses into NASA's covert plan to blow up the moon with a nuclear warhead, the Soviet Union's cover-up of history's deadliest space disaster, and how U.S. attempts to put spies in orbit paved the way for the first space station.

programs.title: Secrets Declassified With David Duchovny
programs.desc: From the seemingly innocuous children's toy engineered to save an informant, to hirsute-inspired movie disguises, the government's most clandestine inventions are never what one would suspect, and that's exactly why no one never saw them coming.

programs.title: Secrets Declassified With David Duchovny
programs.desc: Step inside hidden areas where history was steered in secret, from Churchill's wartime bunker, complete with a direct line to FDR concealed inside his private bathroom, to a Soviet weapons base in the desert exposed only by a daring U-2 spy mission.

programs.title: Secrets Declassified With David Duchovny
programs.desc: David Duchovny exposes a clandestine nuclear blast set off deep below Mississippi soil, secret experiments conducted on citizens in the New York subway system, and a wartime bunker built to trap British spies underground during a Nazi invasion.

programs.title: Secrets Declassified With David Duchovny
programs.desc: Desperation breeds invention - and not all of it conventional. From a British scheme to launch airborne balloons against Nazi Germany, to American bats fitted with incendiary devices, to a covert effort to manipulate monsoon rains in Vietnam, newly unearthed documents reveal how far nations were willing to bend reality to their will. In the risky calculus of war, nothing is too strange to try.

programs.title: Secrets Declassified With David Duchovny
programs.desc: When governments strike dark deals with cults, mobs and even sworn enemies, frosty relationships and mounting tensions are tested head on.
